name: relay
description: Hand-carried transport between sessions and models: paste packets with inbound adjudication, sha-stamped packet files for sessions sharing a filesystem, and durable one-way commission prompts

interface.shortDescription: Carry work between sessions and models by hand without losing anything on the trip
interface.longDescription: Three skills for the case where a human carries work between a session here and a session elsewhere. courier composes self-contained paste packets for a far side that cannot read this disk and adjudicates its replies against local evidence before composing the next leg. relay-by-reference stages each leg of a multi-leg exchange between sessions that share this filesystem as a sha-stamped packet file, so only a pointer line travels. stage-prompt writes a dated, self-contained commission prompt into ~/prompts and commits it for a fresh session to execute one-way.
defaultPrompt: Give me a paste packet for Codex with this review request
Here is the other side's reply; adjudicate it and compose the next leg
Relay this checkpoint to the adjudication seat
Stage this as a commission prompt for a fresh session in another repo
